column3: Close to the Hebrew; NASB uses “was building.”
NASB reads the forty-five as pillars; the Hebrew may count side chambers or beams. The meaning is uncertain.
“Window frames” is rendered “artistic window frames,” and “three times” as “in three ranks.”
“Porch of the pillars” is rendered “hall of pillars.”
“Porch” is rendered “hall.” Many read “from floor to rafters” for the repeated “floor.”
“Wisdom … skill … knowledge” is rendered “wisdom and understanding and skill.”
NASB has “the circumference of both”; the Hebrew reads “the second pillar.”
“Festoons work of chains” is rendered “twisted threads of chainwork.”
The Hebrew order (“pillars … pomegranates”) seems reversed; NASB keeps it. The meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “design.”
“The bulge” is rendered “the rounded projection,” and “the second capital” as “both capitals.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “with the rest.”
Close to the Hebrew; the technical terms are uncertain.
NASB renders “laver” as “basin”; the technical terms are uncertain.
